広 203号

用を支弁するのに不足する。

evaluation_only_normalization: NFKC and whitespace removal; never applied to raw recognition
scope: Root engineering transcription from original source crop, frozen before new cropped OCR but after prior full-page output was seen. Not independent/blind or whole-page accuracy.
frozen_ROI_result: Baseline9 edits; source-crop2 edits in164 normalized gold characters. One crop edit is the correctly recognized第 whose reported bbox extends beyond the frozen ROI. Raw year contains an extra3. Keep this geometry/character distinction; do not widen the ROI to fit output.
